verdict.rationale: Insomnia ships narrow first-party AI features—generating a mock server from a natural-language prompt and AI-suggested Git commit messages—but there's no evidence of a general-purpose built-in AI assistant that a user can delegate broader tasks (e.g., writing scripts, designing APIs, running tests) to. Missing for 10: a general conversational/task-delegation AI assistant, independent hands-on validation of AI feature quality, and evidence of AI assistance beyond mocking/commit messages.
